Very long dark organic cranial dreadlocks gathered and braided down the back; a restrained terminal mace can be attached for armed adults. For infants and juveniles: short soft cranial tendrils, small emerging horn buds; any bare four-mandible mouth is explicitly an original reconstruction, not documented canon.
